cases.description: When the supplied Strategy is null the method should throw a NullPointerException before delegating to the overload.
When the supplied TradeType is null the method should throw a NullPointerException.

group: Delegation to overload with default amount

cases.expected: TradingRecord returned from run(strategy, tradeType, barSeries.one())
cases.description: The method must delegate to the three‑argument overload using the amount returned by barSeries.one(). Verify that the overload is invoked exactly once with the same Strategy, TradeType and the amount from barSeries.one().

cases.expected: TradingRecord returned from run(strategy, tradeType, barSeries.one())
cases.description: Same delegation test for the SELL TradeType to ensure both enum values are passed correctly.
When barSeries.one() returns Num.ZERO the overload should be called with a zero amount, resulting in a TradingRecord that contains no executed trades.

cases.expected: TradingRecord with a single trade of amount = Num.valueOf(1000)
cases.description: When barSeries.one() returns a positive amount (e.g., 1000) the overload should receive that amount and the resulting TradingRecord should reflect trades executed with that amount.

cases.expected: TradingRecord containing a BUY trade at the first index
cases.description: A Strategy that always returns true for shouldEnter should cause the delegated overload to open a BUY trade at the start index. Verify that the returned TradingRecord contains exactly one BUY trade.
A Strategy that never signals entry should result in an empty TradingRecord after delegation.

cases.expected: TradingRecord with one completed BUY‑SELL pair
cases.description: A Strategy that signals entry on the first bar and exit on the second bar should produce a TradingRecord containing a completed BUY trade followed by a SELL exit.

cases.expected: TradingRecord returned from run(strategy, tradeType, Num.valueOf(-500))
cases.description: When barSeries.one() returns a negative Num (e.g., -500), the method must delegate to the three‑argument overload with that exact negative amount. Verify that the overload is invoked once with the same Strategy, TradeType and the negative amount, and that its returned TradingRecord is propagated unchanged.
If barSeries.one() throws an IllegalStateException, run(Strategy, TradeType) must not catch it and should let the exception propagate to the caller.
When the delegated overload run(strategy, tradeType, amount) throws an IllegalArgumentException, the two‑argument method must propagate the same exception without alteration.

cases.expected: TradingRecord returned from run(strategy, tradeType, barSeries.one())
cases.description: Using a spy for the BarSeriesManager, verify that run(strategy, tradeType) calls the three‑argument overload exactly once with the original Strategy instance, the original TradeType enum value, and the amount obtained from barSeries.one(). Ensure no additional calls are made.
If barSeries.one() returns null, the method should throw a NullPointerException before delegating to the overload, because a null amount is not a valid Num.
When the BarSeriesManager is constructed with a null BarSeries, calling run(strategy, tradeType) should throw a NullPointerException before attempting to invoke barSeries.one().
